FC-1C.title: Figure C-1C: Direct Shear Test Data - Shear Stress vs. Shear Displacement; Dilation Displacement vs. Shear Displacement (printed C-4, PDF 118)
FC-1C.legend_hint: legend at the right of the figure
FC-1C.notes_for_reviewers: Seven tests on RS soil at Dr .73 to .88, normal stresses 294 to 3520 psf. The upper curves are dashed and the ink is interrupted around every symbol. The 2935 psf curve (asterisks) has no symbols below about 62 thousandths and shares ink with the 3520 psf curve between about 60 and 75; it runs along the 4000 psf grid line from about 112 to 155. The lower panel is crowded near the zero line: squares sit over x symbols and asterisks beside squares; two symbols on the 100 grid line are hard to identify.

FC-1D.title: Figure C-1D: Direct Shear Test Data - Shear Stress vs. Shear Displacement; Dilation Displacement vs. Shear Displacement (printed C-5, PDF 119)
FC-1D.legend_hint: legend at the right of the figure
FC-1D.notes_for_reviewers: Seven tests on RS soil at Dr 1.0 to 1.16, normal stresses 0 to 3520 psf. The legend has no symbol for the 294 and 0 psf tests: 294 psf is the open circle, 0 psf the filled dot. Several squares (2345 psf) sit well above their drawn line; one x of the 3520 psf test hides on the 50 grid line. Five dilation points lie above the +100 frame line. Near the origin of the lower panel three symbols sit left of the frame; up- and down-triangles overlap into diamond shapes around 68, 89 and 120.

FC-2B.title: Figure C-2B: Direct Shear Test Data - Shear Stress vs. Shear Displacement; Dilation Displacement vs. Shear Displacement (printed C-7, PDF 121)
FC-2B.legend_hint: legend at the right of the figure
FC-2B.notes_for_reviewers: Six tests on PS soil at Dr .33 to .53, normal stresses 734 to 4400 psf (the third is printed 2935). The 734 psf line runs on the 1000 psf grid line for long stretches; the 3660 psf line runs just under the 4000 grid line near its peak. The first symbols of the 4400 and 3660 psf tests coincide. Lower panel: six small symbols are stacked at every displacement; from about 870 to 1330 px across they merge into one blob.

FC-2C.title: Figure C-2C: Direct Shear Test Data - Shear Stress vs. Shear Displacement; Dilation Displacement vs. Shear Displacement (printed C-8, PDF 122)
FC-2C.legend_hint: legend at the right of the figure
FC-2C.notes_for_reviewers: Six tests on PS soil at Dr 1.15 to 1.3, normal stresses 734 to 4400 psf (the third is printed 2935; the legend header prints tau where gamma is meant). Curves merge with grid lines: 2200 psf along the 3000 line, 1468 psf along the 2000 line. Lower panel: small symbols are stacked three or four deep at nearly every displacement; telling a small circle from a small square is the hardest call on this page.
